_comment: Manual 2026 corrections for the draft board. The model labels players with their 2025 team, can't see offseason moves/cuts/suspensions, and blends against a cached crowd ADP that lags breaking news. Sources: nfl.com/sitemap/html/rosters/2026 (scraped 2026-08-31) + fresh Sleeper players/nfl directory and fantasyfootballcalculator.com half-ppr/12/2026 ADP (both re-pulled 2026-09-02, draft day) cross-checked 3-way (model vs Sleeper vs FFC). Names must match models/output/<league>_projections.csv 'name'; matching is punctuation/suffix-insensitive. Team abbreviations follow the board's convention (LA, LV, WAS, JAX).

out.Tyreek Hill: unsigned free agent, out of the league (Nov 2025 knee injury)
out.Ricky Pearsall: season-ending IR (2026 preseason) - no IR slot in this league
out.James Conner: began 2026 on IR, season-ending foot injury - off FFC boards (n=0)
out.Trey Benson: waived by ARI + season-ending knee - off FFC boards (n=0)
out.Brandon Aiyuk: 49ers reserve/left-squad list, has said he will not play for SF in 2026 - off FFC boards
out.Tank Dell: IR to start 2026 (min 4 games, 'nowhere close' per beat) - deep FFC stash only, no IR slot here
out.Christian Kirk: IR to start 2026 (had signed with SF) - off FFC boards (n=0)
out.Dillon Gabriel: IR (backup QB), non-factor in a 1-QB league
out.Isiah Pacheco: IR to start 2026 (signed with DET) - fringe, no IR slot here

_notes.Josh Jacobs: Commissioner's exempt list since ~2026-08-30 (alleged battery), out indefinitely - reporting suggests 6-8 games if charges aren't dropped. FFC's 6-day mean still shows R4 (~42) because the sample predates the news; his latest FFC drafts land ~pick 98 and Sleeper mocks had him ~146. Kept at 146 per user - draftable stash, not a drop. Blend still lands him ~RB14 given the 70% model weight.
_notes.Zach Charbonnet: Reserve/PUP to start 2026 (ACL, Divisional Round) - misses at least the first 4 games. With Kenneth Walker III now in KC he's Seattle's lead back on return, so still worth drafting; adp=135 (FFC R12) feeds the slide into the blend. Lands ~RB16-18 after the 70% model weight.
_notes.Isiah Pacheco: Both Sleeper and FFC now show him on DET, not KC - but he's on IR to start the season and lands in the 'out' list, so the team relabel is moot.
_notes.Jordyn Tyson: Rookie WR (NO), IR to start 2026. No model projection; FFC still drafts him ~R14 (pick 159) so the slide is already priced in - left on the board as an ADP-only row rather than dropped.
